halloween.costume: a mermaid costume: a shimmering teal-and-green sequined fish-scale wrap covering its body from mid-back to its tail, ending in a wide, flared, ruffled fishtail fin over its tail feathers, with its legs and feet left free, a collar of small pearly seashells around the base of its neck, and a wide, clearly visible seafoam-green headband across the crown of its head, with a small coral-pink felt starfish attached to the side of the headband
props: a tiny orange jack-o'-lantern candy pail hanging from a cord around its neck, like a necklace
halloween.caption: Fish Out of Water
